title: BloodyParticles Addon
description: A BloodyParticlesMod Addon that adds particle support for various mods.
body:
# BloodyParticles - Addon Pack (All-in-One)

A single resource pack with blood definitions for 16 mods.

**You don't need to have all the mods installed.** 
BloodyParticles automatically ignores blood definitions for mobs that don't exist in your installation, so you can enable this pack even if you only have some of the supported mods.

## Requires
- The **[Bloody particles!](https://modrinth.com/mod/bloodyparticlesmod)** mod (Forge/Neoforge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1 / Fabric 1.20.1-1.21.1 WIP ).

## Installation
1. Install the BloodyParticles mod.
2. Copy this .zip into your `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable it in Options -> Resource Packs.

## Included mods
- [Alex's Caves](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alexs-caves) (candy mobs WIP)
- [Alex's Mobs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alexs-mobs)
- [Born in Chaos](https://modrinth.com/mod/borninchaos)
- [Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction-forge)
- [Deep Dark: Regrowth](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/deep-dark-regrowth)
- [Deeper and Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker) 
- [Guard Villagers](https://modrinth.com/mod/guard-villagers)
- [Illager Invasion](https://modrinth.com/mod/illager-invasion)
- [Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks)
- [Majrusz's Progressive Difficulty](https://modrinth.com/mod/majruszs-progressive-difficulty)
- [Mowzie's Mobs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mowzies-mobs)
- [Nether's Exorcism Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/nethers-exorcism) (WIP)
- [Raided](https://modrinth.com/mod/raided)
- [Sculk Horde](https://modrinth.com/mod/sculk-horde)
- [Stalwart Dungeons](https://modrinth.com/mod/stalwart-dungeons) (end mobs WIP)
- [True Darkness Elementary](https://modrinth.com/mod/true-darkness-elementary)

## Create your own addon
Use the `bloodyparticles-template` (JSON) to add your own mobs or effects from
your favorite or personal mod. No need to touch the main mod's code.

## DATAPACK
If you want the mod-free experience, you can install my datapack, which offers the same functionality.
[Bloody particles!](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minecraft-bloody-and-full-of-particles!) DATAPACK
